mapper.select: SELECT * FROM game_tournament WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO game_tournament_player (tournament_id, user_id, nickname, seed, status, invited_at, responded_at) VALUES (#{tournamentId}, #{userId}, #{nickname}, #{seed}, #{status}, #{invitedAt}, #{respondedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM game_tournament WHERE kind = 'TOURNAMENT' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.* FROM game_tournament t JOIN game_tournament_player p ON p.tournament_id = t.id WHERE t.kind = 'DUEL' AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM game_tournament WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT * FROM game_tournament WHERE status = 'INVITING' AND invite_deadline <= #{now} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT t.* FROM game_tournament t JOIN game_tournament_player p ON p.tournament_id = t.id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 'INVITED' AND t.kind = 'TOURNAMENT' AND t.status = 'INVITING' AND t.invite_deadline > #{now} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM game_tournament_player WHERE tournament_id = #{tournamentId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM game_tournament_player WHERE tournament_id = #{tournamentId} AND status = 'ACCEPTED' ORDER BY seed ASC, invited_at ASC
SELECT * FROM game_tournament_player WHERE tournament_id = #{tournamentId} AND status IN ('ACCEPTED', 'INVITED') ORDER BY seed ASC, invited_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE game_tournament_player SET seed = #{seed} WHERE tournament_id = #{tournamentId} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE game_tournament SET status = 'RUNNING', bracket_type = #{bracketType}, total_rounds = #{totalRounds}, current_round = 1, started_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{tournamentId} AND status = 'INVITING'
UPDATE game_tournament SET current_round = #{round} WHERE id = #{tournamentId}
UPDATE game_tournament SET bracket_type = #{bracketType}, total_rounds = #{totalRounds} WHERE id = #{tournamentId}
